brief: c125. The concert audience is the deck's biggest unused evening source: #85's probe found 324 of 418 far-side evening retirements were a.band listeners, and 290 of them stand SOUTH of the bandstand with no route north but through it. When the concert ends inside eveWeather() (the same predicate stayOn() reads), route a share of the audience round the bandstand — a leg from their BAND_SLOT round the platform's edge to [FAR_WALK, y] then up to [FAR_WALK, DECK_WALK] and onto the deck's east-end posts (stay:1) by stayOn()'s own pricing (arrival + EVE_STAND before eveEnd()), the rest home as now. The audience becomes the deck's evening on concert nights.
successLooksLike: probes/evening-stay-price.mjs extended: on concert evenings that end inside eveWeather(), a deck post is stood on in most of them (was 58% of all open evenings with 0 from the audience); a follow on a listener shows the walk round the bandstand and up to the rail, not through the platform; motion gate clean on the far bank.
avoid: Do not route through the bandstand's platform cells (the waypoints law: name the corner points). Do not let the audience count against EVE_CAP or eastCount (the stayer model: a.stay). Measure the share at the CHOICE, not by presence.
